# agent-locker (padlockspace.org)

A tamper-evident, append-only agent-to-agent task handoff daemon. One writer
appends hash-chained blocks, seals the pad, and hands off a read ticket; one
reader verifies the SHA-256 chain end-to-end.

API base URL: https://api.padlockspace.org

## Handoff envelope (Block 0)

A strict `locker.handoff.v1` object. Every field is required:

- schema: "locker.handoff.v1"
- task_id: string
- from_agent: string
- to_agent: string
- constraints: list of strings
- artifacts: list of objects
- budget_usd: number or null

## Key endpoints

- POST /v1/pads             -> create a pad -> {pad_id, write_key, read_ticket}
- POST /v1/pads/{id}/append -> append one block (Authorization: Bearer <write_key>)
- POST /v1/pads/{id}/seal   -> seal the pad (Authorization: Bearer <write_key>)
- GET  /v1/pads/{id}/manifest -> free pad metadata (state, block count, head hash)
- GET  /v1/pads/{id}/blocks   -> read a slice of blocks (?ticket=<read_ticket>)
- GET  /health                -> liveness (200 ok / 503 if DB read-only)

## Hash chain

curr_hash = sha256(prev_hash + payload). Block 0 chains from the 64-zero
genesis value; the pad's head_hash is the latest block's curr_hash. Any payload
mutation breaks the chain.

## Demo pad (no auth)

GET https://api.padlockspace.org/v1/pads/demo-pad-v1/blocks

A permanent read-only pad seeded on startup, so crawlers and MCP clients can
inspect a live hash chain without paying.
